features.title: Verified Attendance With GPS and Face Recognition
features.body: Require a location pin and a live selfie during check-in so the worker is physically present at the geofenced site before time is logged. Link each worker's attendance to the activity they are deployed on, so supervisors record output alongside presence.

features.title: Automated Wage Calculation
features.body: Apply configured daily rates, overtime rules, and advance deductions to each worker's verified attendance record and generate wages automatically. Contractor bills can be validated against system-recorded attendance rather than contractor-submitted timesheets.

faqs.q: What is SiteFlow construction labour management software?
faqs.a: It is an enterprise-grade solution to track, manage, and optimize construction workforce operations, integrating GPS attendance, facial recognition, and automated wage calculations.

faqs.q: How does GPS-based attendance prevent ghost workers on construction sites?
faqs.a: By requiring a location pin and a live selfie during check-in, the system ensures the worker is physically present at the designated geofenced site before logging their time.

faqs.q: How does face recognition work in SiteFlow labour attendance?
faqs.a: SiteFlow captures a live selfie at check-in and matches it to the enrolled worker record, so a substitute or absent worker cannot log time against someone else's name.

cta.heading: Stop paying for labour that was never verified on site.
cta.body: Connect GPS and face-verified attendance to automated wages with SiteFlow labour management, and validate every contractor bill against real site time.
